name: Claimants

buildRules.method: Built as standard SF2e creatures via normal creature-building guidelines.
buildRules.level: Leveled to the Frame's tier (12, to start the campaign) — never to the kids' level.
buildRules.groundRule: A Claimant statblock is never something a ground-level kid should be rolling against directly.

namingConvention: Announced by classification code, never named: "Claimant Three, contact confirmed."

lore.framing: Frames the war as a property dispute humanity is losing, and quietly seeds the eventual question of what the Frames themselves are a claim on.
lore.optionalHook: Escheat — property reverting to the state when no rightful heir exists — is a clean legal metaphor for what "the Gap" excavation actually is, if you want to lean into it later.
